Name: More Rings
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]More Rings[/b] adds new rings with special effects.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
This mod adds seven new rings:

[list]
[*][b]﻿Quality+ Ring:[/b] 12.5% chance of higher crop quality.[b][/b]
[*][b]Refreshing Ring:[/b] restore stamina passively.
[*][b]Ring of Diamond Booze:[/b] negate the tipsy effect from alcohol.
[*][b]Ring of Far Reaching:[/b] use tools at a distance.
[*][b]Ring of Regeneration:[/b] regenerate health passively.
[*][b]Ring of True Sight:[/b] see what's in mining nodes and artifact spots.
[*][b]Ring of Wide Nets:[/b] 50% larger fishing bar.
[/list]
See [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/MoreRings#use]the README for more info[/url]﻿, including how to obtain them.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

Known mod conflicts:
[list]
[*]Level Extender may cause Ring of Wide Nets to do nothing, since it overrides the fishing logic.
[/list]
